answer: Each agent stakes reputation like a comet leaves a trail: one identity, one bright signal, one gale of scrutiny. An attacker who mints many agents splits reputation thin, so each sits on a ledge where one exposed sybil forfeits the whole stake. Peer audit finds faint copies cheaply, since a comet with no trail cannot claim flight. Equilibrium: honest agents pool scarce reputation to earn rewards; sybils cannot afford to burn it. No attack pays, so none attempts it.
